حدث مهم في الانتخابات الإسرائيلية:

وقع اليوم رؤساء اكبر اربعة أحزاب في المعارضة غادي أيزنكوت. نفتالي بينيت أفيغدور ليبرمان. يائير لابيد على اتفاق اعتبروه الضربة القاضية لنتنياهو. قال نفتالي بينيت تعليقا على الاتفاق:
 "أنا واثق من قدرتنا على الفوز بـ 63 مقعدًا، وأننا معًا سنُصلح إسرائيل. يمكن للشعب الإسرائيلي بأكمله اليوم أن يرفع رأسه عاليًا. معًا سنحقق النصر".

خليل الحية:

- وافقنا على خارطة الطريق التي قدمها ملادينوف والوسطاء ونحن جاهزون لتطبيقها

- خارطة الطريق تبدأ باستكمال المرحلة الأولى من اتفاق غزة وتنتهي بإقامة الدولة الفلسطينية 

- ملادينوف يبذل جهدا لتطبيق الخارطة لكن "إسرائيل" تحتاج إلى جهد دولي لإلزامها

- ملادينوف يمثل مجلس السلام، نلومه أحيانا ونتفهم مواقفه، وعليه أن يؤدي دوره كاملا

🎙 President of Russia Vladimir Putin’s answers to media questions (St Petersburg, September 25, 2026)

Key talking points:

• The Russian Armed Forces’ recent actions were yet again retaliatory [to Ukraine’s reckless provocations] and proved so painful and devastating for the adversary that they are now once again actively raising the issue of ceasefires in several areas – energy and airspace, as they put it. But they were the ones who started all of this.

• Is this some kind of children’s game to them? They must therefore feel the impact of Russia’s retaliatory strikes and understand that no provocations or escalation will bring them the results they seek. They are only making their own situation worse.

• All these moves towards so-called reconciliation and proposals to resume negotiations are on the table. All of this is possible. But after everything they have done, we will think very carefully about what action we need to take in response.

❗️ I want to stress once again: we are not preparing for any military action against Europe. We have no such plans and, most importantly, no grounds or real motives for escalating the situation with Europe, whatever anyone may say, including those in the Baltic states.

• We will continue to stand up for the rights of our compatriots, within the framework of international law. We have never intended to use other means, have never used them and have no intention of doing so.

• We welcome negotiations between the US and China. Why? Because these are the world’s two largest economies. How they resolve their differences and the problems arising from illegitimate US sanctions, and what agreements they reach, will influence the entire global economy, including our own.

• The APEC Summit in China is a major, important event, and I have been invited. I believe it would be useful to take part in such a forum. I have told President Xi Jinping this as well. I intend to participate. But, as I have said, the final decision will depend on the situation in Russia.

#degenerate_economist 

There's this hilarious trend going on social media where a bunch of trading gurus are doing Ai edits of themselves in fancy cars with women, and some dumbasses are falling for it and buying their courses.

Let's make this clear, if you make more 30-50% a year (these guys claim 500+%) constantly risk adjusted and a good sharpe ratio.. You'll be scouted by a hedge fund or a major bank to manage billions of dollars.

You will NOT be online trying to sell courses and having telegram signal channels. It's just not worth it and quite frankly it's pathetic. 

At minimum you'll be a world champion in the Robin's cup (something like a trader's version of e-sports champions) to prove your track record accurate. 

So please, don't waste your money buying courses, the actual knowledge exists in textbooks. 

if you actually want to get into this field, look at getting a CFA certificate, something that would ACTUALLY teach you how to manage money and would land you a decent paying job on the desks of some financial institution. 

Oh and btw, you can apply to a CFA program from anywhere in the world and it's basically accredited everywhere, i happen to be a level 3 CFA myself.

It's 100% worth the money, especially if you're a 3rd worlder that wants to leave his country and not work as a dishwasher for the rest of his life.

Note: you need to have a financial field related degree (even if it's business management) in order to apply.
